PostgreSQL I/O patterns showing disk reads and buffer hits, indicating storage performance and cache effectiveness.

Background writer and checkpoint statistics showing write activity and performance, critical for PostgreSQL durability and performance.

panels.description:
**Lock Types Distribution**

Distribution of PostgreSQL lock types showing the different lock modes currently held in the system. This helps identify lock contention patterns and understand concurrent access behavior.

*Note: Shows 'No data' when no locks are currently held, which is normal for idle systems.*
panels.title: PostgreSQL Lock Types Distribution

panels.description:
**Lock Waits and Deadlocks**

Monitors PostgreSQL lock contention over time, showing deadlocks and waiting states from active connections. Rising trends indicate increased lock contention that may impact performance.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Lock Waits and Deadlocks

panels.description:
**Extension Dependencies Information**

Some panels in this section require PostgreSQL extensions to be installed:

• **pg_stat_statements**: Required for detailed query performance metrics
• **pg_stat_progress_vacuum**: Required for vacuum progress monitoring

If these extensions are not available, fallback metrics will be displayed instead. To enable full functionality, install the required extensions:

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;
```

options.content:
## Extension Dependencies

**Some panels require PostgreSQL extensions:**

- **pg_stat_statements**: Detailed query performance metrics
- **pg_stat_progress_vacuum**: Vacuum progress monitoring

**If extensions are missing, fallback metrics will be shown.**

**To enable full functionality:**
```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;
```

panels.title: Extension Dependencies

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Query Duration Distribution**

Distribution of query execution times using pg_stat_statements extension. Shows query performance patterns and helps identify slow queries. Falls back to basic transaction metrics when pg_stat_statements is not available.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Query Duration Distribution

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Slow Queries**

Queries with execution time above threshold using pg_stat_statements. Helps identify performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities. Shows fallback metrics when pg_stat_statements extension is not available.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Slow Queries

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Queries by Type**

Breakdown of database operations by type (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) showing query distribution patterns and workload characteristics.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Queries by Type

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Index Usage Efficiency**

Comparison of index scans vs sequential scans showing index utilization efficiency. High sequential scan rates may indicate missing or ineffective indexes.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Index Usage Efficiency

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Index Scan Ratio**

Percentage of table accesses that use indexes vs sequential scans. Higher percentages indicate better index utilization and query optimization.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Index Scan Ratio

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Temporary Files**

Monitoring of temporary files created by PostgreSQL for operations that exceed work_mem. Shows both the number of temporary files and total bytes used, indicating memory pressure and query complexity.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Temporary Files

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Sort Operations**

Monitoring of sort operations efficiency showing sorts performed in memory vs disk. High disk sorts indicate insufficient work_mem configuration and can impact query performance.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Sort Operations

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Network Traffic**

Network I/O patterns showing inbound and outbound traffic for the PostgreSQL instance. This helps monitor network utilization and identify potential bottlenecks in database connectivity.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Network Traffic

panels.description:
**PostgreSQL Memory Usage Breakdown**

Comprehensive view of PostgreSQL memory allocation patterns including shared buffers, background writer statistics, and memory-related metrics. This helps monitor memory efficiency and identify potential memory bottlenecks.

**Shared Buffers**: PostgreSQL's main memory cache for data pages, equivalent to InnoDB buffer pool.
**Background Writer Buffers**: Buffers written by the background writer process.
**Checkpoint Buffers**: Buffers written during checkpoint operations.
**Backend Buffers**: Buffers written directly by backend processes.
**Temporary File Usage**: Indicates when work_mem is insufficient and operations spill to disk.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Memory Usage Breakdown

panels.description:
**Memory Allocation Efficiency**

Key memory efficiency metrics showing how effectively PostgreSQL is using allocated memory resources.

**Buffer Allocation Rate**: Rate at which new buffers are allocated.
**Buffer Eviction Rate**: Rate at which buffers are evicted from memory.
**Memory Context Usage**: Memory allocated for various PostgreSQL contexts (when available).
**Work Memory Pressure**: Estimated pressure on work_mem based on temporary file creation.
panels.title: Memory Allocation Efficiency

panels.description:
**VACUUM and ANALYZE Operations**

Monitoring of PostgreSQL maintenance operations showing VACUUM and ANALYZE activity across tables. These operations are critical for maintaining query performance and preventing table bloat.

**VACUUM Operations**: Remove dead tuples and update statistics, essential for space reclamation.
**ANALYZE Operations**: Update table statistics used by the query planner for optimal execution plans.
**Last VACUUM/ANALYZE**: Shows when maintenance operations were last performed on each table.
**Operation Frequency**: Rate of maintenance operations over time.
panels.title: VACUUM and ANALYZE Operations

panels.description:
**Autovacuum Activity**

Monitoring of PostgreSQL's autovacuum daemon activity showing automated maintenance operations performance and efficiency.

**Autovacuum Operations**: Automatic VACUUM operations triggered by the autovacuum daemon.
**Autoanalyze Operations**: Automatic ANALYZE operations for statistics updates.
**Last Autovacuum/Autoanalyze**: Timestamps of the most recent automatic maintenance operations.
**Dead Tuples**: Number of dead tuples that trigger autovacuum operations.
**Autovacuum Efficiency**: Ratio of autovacuum operations to table modifications.
panels.title: Autovacuum Activity

panels.description:
**Background Writer Statistics**

Monitoring of PostgreSQL's background writer process showing checkpoint and background write activity. The background writer is responsible for writing dirty buffers to disk to maintain system performance.

**Checkpoint Operations**: Scheduled and requested checkpoint operations for data durability.
**Background Writer Buffers**: Buffers written by the background writer process.
**Buffer Sync Operations**: Synchronization operations for buffer management.
**Checkpoint Duration**: Time taken for checkpoint operations to complete.
**Write Performance**: Rate of buffer writes and checkpoint efficiency.
panels.title: Background Writer Statistics

panels.description:
**Table Statistics**

Per-table performance statistics showing sequential scans, index scans, tuples read and fetched. This helps identify table access patterns and optimization opportunities.
panels.title: Table Statistics

panels.description:
**Index Statistics**

Per-index performance statistics showing index scans, tuples read and fetched. This helps identify index usage efficiency and optimization opportunities.
panels.title: Index Statistics

panels.description:
**Database Size Monitoring**

Database growth trends showing the size of each database over time. This helps with capacity planning and identifying databases that are growing rapidly.
panels.title: Database Size Monitoring
